# Materials Data Explorer

> Joyita Bhattacharya's articles, Python tutorials and interactive examples connect materials science, microscopy and data analysis. The explanations begin with concrete examples and develop the code in small steps.

## Browse
- [Articles](https://bjoyita.github.io/blog_list.html): Materials, images, machine learning and materials design.
- [Tutorials](https://bjoyita.github.io/tutorial_list.html): Practical calculations and explained code.

## Begin here
- [PCA for materials data](https://bjoyita.github.io/posts/pca-materials.html): The first article in a four-part introduction.
- [Microstructure reconstruction game](https://bjoyita.github.io/tutorials/microstructure-pca-game.html): Generate patterns and explore PCA reconstruction.
- [Generate simulated images](https://bjoyita.github.io/Tutorial_1.html): Build synthetic images in Python.
- [SHAP and materials design](https://bjoyita.github.io/Blog5_SHAP.html): Interpret model predictions using thermoelectric measurements.
- [AI and materials discovery](https://bjoyita.github.io/posts/ai-materials-discovery.html): Generative models and materials for energy and sustainability.

## Sources and terms
- [Sitemap](https://bjoyita.github.io/sitemap.xml): Public page URLs.
- [Copyright and licensing](https://bjoyita.github.io/Copyright.html): Terms for using the material.

Consult the linked articles for their definitions, assumptions, source references and limitations. Link to the original page when citing it.
